t: You are standing in Carlyle Square, a garden square just off the King's Road in Chelsea. It was laid out on market gardens and was first called Oakley Square. In 1872 it was renamed in honour of the writer Thomas Carlyle. The actress Dame Sybil Thorndike lived here from 1921 to 1932. Her stage career ran from 1904 to 1969, so she was well into it when she called this quiet square home.
